name: Authorized Website Crawl to Vector Store (Apify)

parameters.customBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ startUrl: $json.startUrl, authorizationConfirmed: $json.authorizationConfirmed, maxPages: $json.maxPages, maxDepth: $json.maxDepth, maxRuntimeSeconds: $json.maxRuntimeSeconds }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{query:"What key information and topics are covered in the crawled pages?"}}];

parameters.content:
This example uses n8n Simple Vector Store for a development run.
Its memory is shared across instance users and is lost on restart. Use a persistent vector store for production and keep this memory key unique.
Collect only pages you own or are authorized to process, subject to site terms.

Setup: connect both Gemini Embeddings nodes to a Google Gemini(PaLM) API credential and keep the same embedding model for insert and retrieval. The credential is intentionally not included. Run only against pages you own or are authorized to process. The Simple Vector Store is shared in memory and clears when this workflow runs; use persistent storage for production.
